name: Canoweissmon
main_effect:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers becomes suspended, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, if this Digimon has 12000 DP or more, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
